track.label: My track record
track.foot: I record each forecast the moment I show it, with the range I gave, and grade it once its time has passed, from measured figures only. A grade can’t be changed.
track.cantTell: “Can’t tell” means the measured figures weren’t there, or something I didn’t forecast got in the way, such as a delivery. It never counts as right.
